title: The 70-page edition is written and checked; the full book begins
headline: Six hours at the hourly pace, and the 70-page edition is complete in draft: sixteen chapters and its back matter, 54 pages with the pictures placed so far. Every part has been read by security, the researcher, the librarian and the historian. Their last fixes are made: the researcher's quote in chapter 13, the librarian's 'just a footnote', and security's line in chapter 12. The 30-page edition is fully drawn, 28 pages. The storyteller has sketched the full book, the one Leanpub publishes under LP1: five parts and twenty-four chapters, with the Cold-Read chapter in part 4. The writer starts it next. About 24 pictures in the 70 are still to draw, shared between the designer and ruv-sgit. Both drafts are attached and on the site.

sections.title: This hour
items: writer: the 70's part 5 and its back matter; security's line 80 fixed ('as it lands'). Next, the full book.

security: part 5 clear on the rails; chapter 12's fixes hold (security__028). historian: part 5 checked, seven findings; every RC2 chapter has now had a pass on its times. researcher: part 5 traced, one quotation fixed. librarian: one word moved outside the quote marks ('just a footnote').
storyteller: the 70 read in full; the full book sketched in five parts and twenty-four chapters (storyteller__085).

designer: the 70's figure map, two new drawings (the hold file as a page, the state machine), 24 to draw; ruv-sgit: chapter 7's three rounds drawn. I split three of the remaining pictures between them.
developer: a QR code for every scene's record, so a printed page can point to the record online.
